description.name: Entry
description.text: Fifteen single attacks (1.50 each), grants [ATK, DEF, MAG and RES +30% (25s)] to all allies, grants [Weakness +9% Boost (15s)]/[Weakness +15% Boost (15s)]/[Weakness +30% Boost (15s)] to all allies if 0-1/2-3/4+ FF3 allies are alive, grants [High Quick Cast 1] to all allies if 4+ FF3 allies are alive, grants [Attach Dark], [Awoken Dark] and [Damage Cap +10000] to the user

description.name: Weakness +9% Boost (15s)
description.text: Increases damage dealt by 9% when exploiting elemental weaknesses

description.name: Weakness +15% Boost (15s)
description.text: Increases damage dealt by 15% when exploiting elemental weaknesses

description.name: Weakness +30% Boost (15s)
description.text: Increases damage dealt by 30% when exploiting elemental weaknesses

description.name: Attach Dark
description.text: Replaces Attack command, increases Dark damage dealt by 50/80/120% (abilities) or 80/100/120% (Soul Breaks), Dark resistance +20%

description.name: Awoken Dark
description.text: Dark abilities don't consume uses and deal 5/10/15/20/30% more damage at ability rank 1/2/3/4/5, Dark abilities trigger 1 additional time
